figures.caption: Percentage of PI + cells for S. aureus and E. coli treated with ∼0.5 × MBC of melittin, melittin dimers, and Lys-substituted melittin. After 90 min incubation of either S. aureus or E. coli with each peptide at ∼0.5 × MBC, cells were treated with Syto9 and PI and analyzed on a flow cytometer. The percentage of PI + cells was then calculated from two biological replicates. The error bars represent the standard deviation of the sample size.
